## 9/14 — Advanced Data Visualization 1/2

### ggplot grammar

data + mapping + geom + scale + labels + theme

``` r
ggplot(data, aes(x = x_var, y = y_var)) +
  geom_point()
```

### Mapping vs setting

- inside `aes()` → variable mapping
- outside `aes()` → fixed setting
- `aes(color = group)` → color by group
- `color = "blue"` → all blue

### Documentation

- Usage → argument order
- Arguments → meaning
- Aesthetics → x / y / color / fill / size
- Examples → code patterns
- key args: `mapping`, `data`, `...`

### Geoms

- `geom_point()`
- `geom_line()`
- `geom_linerange()`
- `geom_rect()`

[Course lesson](https://hash-mac.github.io/ds212site-f26/activities/03-adv-ggplot.html)

## 9/16 — Advanced Data Visualization 2/2

### Layers

- each geom = one layer
- later layer = on top
- different data per layer
- different mapping per layer

``` r
ggplot() +
  geom_linerange(
    data = weather,
    aes(dateInYear, ymin = RecordLow, ymax = RecordHigh)
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    data = weather,
    aes(dateInYear, ymin = Low, ymax = High),
    color = "#A90248"
  )
```

### SFO plot

- record range = background
- normal range = middle
- actual range = foreground
- month cuts = `geom_vline()`
- record day = point / triangle
- monthly total = text

### Story check

question → comparison → visual emphasis

- title / subtitle
- labels / units
- caption / source
- useful color only
- no extra decoration

[R4DS: Data visualization](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/data-visualize.html)

## 9/21 — Advanced Spatial 2/2

### Layer order

raster → polygons → water → points → labels

``` r
ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = elev_df, aes(x, y, fill = elevation)) +
  geom_sf(data = mn_counties, fill = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = mn_cities)
```

### Functions

- `st_join()` → spatial join
- `st_crop()` → smaller area

## 9/23 — Advanced Wrangling I

### Vector types

- logical
- integer
- double
- character
- Date / POSIXct
- factor
- one vector → one type
- coercion → common type

### Logical

- `>` `<` `>=` `<=` `==` `!=`
- membership: `%in%`
- NOT: `!`
- AND: `&`
- OR: `|`
- missing: `is.na()`

### NA logic

- `TRUE & NA` → `NA`
- `FALSE & NA` → `FALSE`
- `TRUE | NA` → `TRUE`
- `FALSE | NA` → `NA`
- `sum(condition)` → count
- `mean(condition)` → proportion

### Recycling

short vector → repeated

- compatible length = okay
- wrong length = bug / warning
- membership → `%in%`

## 9/30 — Advanced Wrangling II

### Strings

- backslash: `\\`

- tab: `\t`
- combine: `str_c()`
- template: `str_glue()`

### Keys / joins

## 10/2 — Missing Data

### Types

- explicit → row exists + `NA`
- implicit → row absent
- `complete()` → implicit to explicit
- `fill()` → carry value
- `replace_na()` → fixed value
- `NaN` → not a number
- most functions: `NaN` ≈ `NA`

### Empty groups

``` r
data |>
  count(category, .drop = FALSE)
```

### Mechanisms

- MCAR
  - unrelated to data
  - complete case unbiased
  - sample size ↓
- MAR
  - related to observed variables
  - multiple imputation
- MNAR
  - related to missing / unobserved value
  - bias risk ↑

### Quality checks

- keep raw data
- check parsing
- check missingness
- check join keys
- predict rows
- duplicates?
- `anti_join()` → unmatched
- visualize / sanity check

### Explore missingness

- by variable
- by case
- missing vs observed groups
- single imputation → uncertainty ignored
- multiple imputation → uncertainty included

[R4DS: Missing values](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/missing-values.html)

## 10/5 — Functions 1/2

### Why?

- repeat code
- copy/paste errors ↓
- update once
- reuse
- clear name

### Parts

``` r
name <- function(argument, default_arg = value) {
  body
}
```

- name
- arguments
- defaults
- body
- return value

### Calling

- positional: `f(2, 4)`
- named: `f(x = 2, y = 4)`
- positional → order matters
- named → clearer

### Workflow

working code → changing parts → arguments → name → test

### Scope

- inside = local
- outside = global
- local masks global
- inputs through arguments
- avoid hidden globals

### Vector function

vector(s) → vector

``` r
rescale01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE, finite = TRUE)
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}
```

[R4DS: Functions](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/functions.html)

## 10/7 — Functions 2/2

### Calling functions

- by position → order matters
- by name → safer / clearer
- defaults → can leave argument out
- test small examples first

### Conditions

``` r
if (condition) {
  do_this
} else if (other_condition) {
  do_that
} else {
  something_else
}
```

- `if` → one TRUE / FALSE
- `if_else()` → vector
- `case_when()` → several conditions
- temperature conversion example
- invalid input → return message

### Functions + tidyverse

- column names work differently inside functions
- embrace variable: `{{ variable }}`
- multiple columns: `pick({{ variables }})`
- data frame stays normal argument

``` r
group_means <- function(df, group_var, mean_var) {
  df |>
    group_by({{ group_var }}) |>
    summarize(mean = mean({{ mean_var }}))
}
```

### Main idea

working code → find changing parts → arguments → function → test

- repeated 3+ times → probably function
- avoid hidden global objects
- output should be predictable

## 10/9 — Base R

### R objects

- vector = same type
- list = mixed types / objects
- matrix = one type + rows / cols
- data frame = named list, columns same length
- tibble = data frame, stricter printing

### Subsetting

- `x[1:3]` → subset, keeps container type
- `x[-1]` → drop first
- `x[x > 5]` → keep TRUE positions
- named object: `x[c("a", "b")]`
- rows / cols: `df[1:3, ]`, `df[, 1]`
- `$` or `[[ ]]` → pull one element
- list: `x[1]` = list, `x[[1]]` = thing inside

### Structure / debugging

- `class()` → object class
- `length()` → number of elements
- `dim()` → dimensions
- `str()` → structure / nested pieces
- `print()` / `cat()` → check values while code runs
- `browser()` → pause inside function
- `stop()` → create error
- `try()` → keep going after error

[Course lesson](https://hash-mac.github.io/ds212site-f26/activities/10-base-r.html)

## 10/12 — Iteration 1/2

### Main idea

- function = save one task
- iteration = repeat task on new inputs
- output needed → store results
- side effect only → print / save / write

### For loop

``` r
for (i in seq_along(x)) {
  result[i] <- f(x[i])
}
```

- `i` = current index
- `seq_along(x)` → 1 to length of x
- `seq_len(n)` → 1 to n
- make storage first: `vector("numeric", length(x))`
- list output: `vector("list", length(x))`
- do not grow output with `c()` inside loop

### Data frames

- data frame = list of columns
- `for (col in df)` → each column
- rows: `for (i in seq_len(nrow(df)))`
- one column: `df[[i]]`

### Across columns

- `across()` → same function on several columns
- `where(is.numeric)` → choose numeric columns

``` r
data |>
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
```

- vectorized function first if available
- loop when steps repeat and no ready function

[Course lesson](https://hash-mac.github.io/ds212site-f26/activities/11-iteration-1.html)
